The '''ILF-5000 Life Form Scanner''' was a specialized scanner that was tuned to locate and identify life forms. The device could hold data on ten species at a time and would automatically indicate if it detected one of them. If it detected a life form not programmed into it, it would just give the size, distance and direction of the life form.
